actions_english.prompt:
Respond with detailed but simple instructions in English. Each line must consists of only one action, where the mentioned objects must be items from the following list: ['chicken leg', 'cabinet right door', 'cabinet left door', 'cabinet', 'stove on the left', 'stove on the right', 'counter top on the left', 'counter top on the right', 'pot lid', 'pot body', 'pot bottom', 'stove knob on the right', 'stove knob on the left', 'kitchen sink', 'faucet handle', 'fridge', 'fridge door', 'fridge shelf', 'salt shaker', 'pepper shaker'].

    Currently, you can see the following objects: ``the pot lid is on the stove on the left,
the pot body is on the counter top on the right,
the chicken leg is on the fridge shelf,
the salt shaker is in the cabinet,
the pepper shaker is in the cabinet,
cabinet right door is partially open,
cabinet left door is partially open,
fridge door is partially open,
stove knob on the right is turned off,
stove knob on the left is turned off,
faucet handle is turned off''
Use the following contexts for creating your action sequence:
This is a very simple but tasty soup, that is sure to keep you ,in the Northern Hemisphere, hot this winter.
1.
Cut chicken into 4 pcs
2.
Wash chicken well with salt and lemon
3.
Rinse, and season with salt and pepper
4.
Place chicken,gizzard, onions, carrots and water in a stockpot and simmer 2 hrs
5.
Add in the garlic ( peeled whole)tomato, salt, pepper and cook another 30 min or possibly till chicken is very tender.
6.
Remove bones and skin,and shred chicken .
7.
Meanwhile, place remaining soup mixture in a small saucepan over low heat.
Stir in cornstarch to thicken, and cook over low heat until heated through.
Use this as a sauce when chicken is done.
PUT the chicken back in the soup along with the beans and spinach and simmer the soup for about 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.
PUT half the garlic and saffron mayonnaise in a mixing bowl and whisk in the hot soup.
Place a slice of French bread toast in the bottom of each wide soup bowl and ladle the soup over it.
If youve left the chicken pieces whole, prop the chicken up on the toasts and ladle the soup over that.
